title: MLINE LTYPE XDATA code-1005 LWPOLYLINE targets in ENTITIES and named BLOCKS

scope.source: Runtime-generated ASCII/binary DXF records; no repository drawing fixture was added.
scope.cross_product: One selected LWPOLYLINE profile was exercised for all four ASCII/binary source and output combinations in each of two source sections.
scope.linetype: EditDash with two simple dash segments [1.0, -0.5], declared length 1.5, source flags 0 and alignment 65.
scope.xdata: One source-bound APPID, one group-1000 payload, then one ordered group-1005 soft pointer.

proof.source: The physical LTYPE XDATA sequence is bound to its APPID. Each target is uniquely identified by source handle, source section, block-record owner, parsed callback and exact DRW_LWPolyline dynamic type. The authored geometry distinguishes a closed three-vertex polyline with non-default elevation, per-vertex widths, positive and negative bulges, and identifiers.
proof.output: For both source sections and all four encoding pairs, emitted physical XDATA is checked against the remapped target handle. The model-space target is emitted in ENTITIES under *Model_Space; the named target remains in BLOCKS under AuthorityBlock. Physical output and fresh typed readback verify owner, flags, elevation, ordered XY coordinates, widths, bulges and identifiers.
proof.failure_retry: For each section and encoding pair, removing the LWPOLYLINE target refuses export and preserves the prior destination; restoring it permits same-adapter retry. Separate late-mutation probes change the target handle after APPID emission in ENTITIES and BLOCKS; finalization refuses without replacing the destination, and restoring the original handle permits same-adapter retry with physical output and typed readback.

focused_ctest.result: PASS (1/1, 15.90 seconds); selector asserts whole-test counts listed above

limits: This qualifies one AC1027 LWPOLYLINE target in model-space ENTITIES and one in named AuthorityBlock BLOCKS, each with one ordered code-1005 XDATA reference. It does not qualify other LWPOLYLINE sections, target entity types, larger reference counts, versions, provider schemas or application meanings.

This is selected transport, source identity, output, typed readback and transaction evidence only; it does not establish native consumer acceptance, recursive document closure, all LWPOLYLINE semantics or format support claims.
